sources.description: Jaguars wide receiver Brian Thomas didn't have any catches in the team's final two games before their Week 7 bye and he found himself on the bench for all of the second half of their Week 6 loss to the Texans, which led head coach Liam Coen to say that "guys have to step up and make plays" if they want to be on the field.
